study_identification.author_journal_year: Tong et al., Journal of Affective Disorders, 2024
study_identification.title: Individual deviations from normative electroencephalographic connectivity predict antidepressant response

study_characteristics.study_objective: This study aimed to develop a normative modeling framework based on rsEEG FC to identify clinically translatable pretreatment biomarkers for antidepressant response prediction.

preprocessing_pipeline.answer: Brainstorm toolbox; OpenMEEG plugin; FreeSurfer; ComBat

quality_checking_detail.answer: Automated artifact rejection pipeline including resampling, line noise removal, filtering, bad epoch/channel rejection, interpolation for bad channels, and ICA for remaining artifacts.

site_effect_handling_detail.answer: ComBat was used for data harmonization across the three cohorts, with cohort origin as the batch variable and age as a covariate.

nm_vldtn_handle_ns.reason: The study explicitly addresses site effects, a major source of nuisance variance, by using ComBat for harmonization across the three different HC cohorts. They also regress out age from the deviation features before predictive modeling to avoid confounding.
nm_vldtn_handle_ns.supporting_text: The utilization of multiple independent cohorts requires data harmonization to eliminate potential site effects...The data harmonization was realized with a MATLAB package built on empirical Bayesian methods (ComBat...)...we incorporated age as a covariate in the data harmonization to ensure the eliminated differences were indeed site effects. ... we regressed out age from individual deviation features to ensure that the brain signatures we identified were not confounded by age.

nm_vldtn_same_domain_nonindep.reason: The study uses 10-fold cross-validation to evaluate the performance of the prediction models. This is a standard method for validation on a non-independent dataset (the training set).
nm_vldtn_same_domain_nonindep.supporting_text: The performances of prediction models were then evaluated using 10-fold cross-validation.

nm_vldtn_same_domain_indep.reason: The study performs a leave-study-site-out analysis, where the model is trained on data from three sites and tested on the held-out site. This represents validation on an independent dataset from the same domain.
nm_vldtn_same_domain_indep.supporting_text: To assess the reliability of biomarker findings, we performed a leave-study-site-out analysis for the normative modeling-based framework for antidepressant response prediction. Specifically, as the EMBARC dataset includes subjects from four study sites, we trained the prediction models using data from three sites and then evaluated the performance on data from the held-out study site.

nm_vldtn_diff_domain.reason: The study does not validate the model on a dataset from a different domain (e.g., a different disorder or a dataset with different acquisition parameters not harmonized). The leave-site-out is still within the same study (EMBARC).
nm_vldtn_diff_domain.supporting_text: Future studies are also needed to validate the generalizability of our proposed framework to other antidepressants, psychotherapy, neurostimulation therapy, as well as these treatment strategies for other psychiatric disorders.

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: LASSO regression on CPM-selected features to predict HAMD17 score change.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: A normative model of EEG connectivity predicted antidepressant response for both sertraline (r=0.43) and placebo (r=0.33) and identified distinct neural signatures for each.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: The autoencoder-based normative model significantly predicted sertraline response (r=0.43, p<0.001) and placebo response (r=0.33, p<0.001) in MDD patients, outperforming predictions based on raw EEG data and other normative modeling techniques (PCA, regression). The study identified distinct predictive connectivity patterns for sertraline (transmodal networks) and placebo (unimodal networks), suggesting independent neurobiological pathways.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: Findings require replication in independent cohorts. The generalizability to other treatments and disorders needs to be validated. The study could not confirm connectivity changes post-treatment as end-of-treatment neuroimaging data was not collected.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: The proposed unsupervised autoencoder framework is highly generalizable and provides a robust method for quantifying individual deviations in psychopathology, potentially adaptable for various treatments and psychiatric disorders.

general_notes.general_notes: The study provides a novel unsupervised normative modeling approach using autoencoders, which is less reliant on pre-defined covariates compared to traditional regression-based methods. The paper also includes a comparison with other normative modeling techniques.
